headline: Kings Cage Erupts as Stlican Shelf Swings to the Colonials
war_summary: Three hours have brought a new thunderhead. Kings Cage, slumbering when we last went to press, has erupted: casualty returns that ran to a dozen an hour now mount into the hundreds, and fighting stood logged at the Den of Knaves as this edition closed. Stlican Shelf has turned as well, the Colonials now leading five works to four after a day of thirty-odd actions about Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn, eight of them in the past two hours. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest front of all — thirty-seven base actions in a day, Necropolis and Spirit Watch the most contended — though the works there have gone still these two hours while casualty ledgers climb, and the one ruined post of yesterday stands re-manned. In the Dead Lands no base has changed hands since morning, yet losses swell at a fearful rate; Callahans Passage has been quiet at the works since midday, its guns warming anew. Godcrofts and Farranac Coast log fresh actions; Marban Hollow's casualty rolls climb steeply. By our count the Colonials hold 260 works to the Wardens' 176. It is the war's one-hundred-forty-sixth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
